[FACT] User is assessing a research proposal of an undergraduate student.  
[FACT] The research proposal is titled "A proposal to defining the correlation between endometriosis risk and gene variants through the studies of genome-wide association and exome sequencing."  
[FACT] The academic year for the proposal is 2022-23.  
[FACT] The proposal discusses endometriosis, a chronic disease affecting 10% of women globally.  
[FACT] The proposal mentions that endometriosis often manifests as pelvic pain and/or infertility.  
[FACT] The proposal states that endometriosis is partly genetically inherited with a heritability of ~50%.  
[FACT] The proposal references genome-wide association (GWA) studies and exome sequencing as research tools.  
[FACT] The proposal includes a case-control study in Greece by Matalliotakis et al (2017).  
[FACT] The proposal discusses the importance of conducting GWA studies on large populations of differing ethnic backgrounds.  
[FACT] The proposal mentions that exome sequencing is a cost-effective approach to genome research.  
[FACT] The proposal examines three single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs): rs7521902, rs10859871, rs11031006.  
[FACT] The proposal indicates that the allele variants located on the loci WNT4 and FSHB could be correlated with endometriosis risk.  
[FACT] The proposal emphasizes the need for additional exome sequencing studies.
